Storage._comment_cloud: Set Provider=S3 + the fields below to enable the cloud tier (recommended target: Cloudflare R2 — ADR-009). For R2: Region='auto', ForcePathStyle=true, EndpointUrl=https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. Credentials go in secrets (ADR-006), never here.

OrderPhotoArchive._comment: Intent 024 promote-on-paid lifecycle (bolt 051). MaxAttempts × Backoff sets the per-order retry envelope; the backoff schedule is indexed by Attempt-1 and clamps at the last value. PromotionRecoverySweepIntervalHours is the periodic self-heal cadence (F1, review 043-v3).

Archive._comment: Intent 024 retention lifecycle (bolt 052). PurgeOriginalAtStatus must be 'Shipped' or 'Delivered'. RetentionMonths is measured from Order.PaidAt — see ADR-012.

Sameday._comment: Intent 015 Sameday courier integration. Flip Enabled=true after credentials are provisioned in user-secrets (dev) or env vars (prod). With Enabled=false the static fallback IShippingService stays registered — see ADR-013/014. Credentials NEVER in appsettings.json (ADR-006).
Sameday._serviceIdsComment: Per-merchant Sameday service ids — set both to the real ids from your Sameday contract before enabling. 7 is a placeholder locker code.

Jobs._comment: Bolt 037 AWB + tracking lifecycle jobs. Orthogonal to Sameday:Enabled — keep Jobs:Enabled=false during initial rollout so credentials can be validated via the typed client before the workflow goes live. See ADR-015/016.

SecurityHeaders.ContentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://js.stripe.com https://accounts.google.com; frame-src https://js.stripe.com; connect-src 'self' https://api.stripe.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'

Sentry._comment: Intent 020 bolt 045 error tracking. Flip Enabled=true once Dsn is provisioned via user-secrets (dev) or env vars (prod). With Enabled=false the SDK is never constructed — production-identical to baseline. Dsn NEVER in appsettings.json (ADR-006). Release auto-derives from GIT_COMMIT_SHA env var (set by deploy workflow, bolt 040).
